annotations.title: What changed? Travel advisory change feed, every country, US + UK, last N days

description: Use daily for travel-risk monitoring: every US State Department advisory reissued/updated and every UK FCDO travel advice update in the window, newest first, with the current US level and each government's own change note, plus a per-country roll-up. One call replaces polling ~200 countries x 2 governments. Optional: days (1-30, default 7), countries (watch-list), source (both|us|uk), min_us_level (1-4). PAID: $0.040 per call, no API key or account, or free with a Trip Desk Pass. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base) or MPP over MCP (USDC.e on Tempo); an unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing. Bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/advisory/changes.

countries.description: Optional watch-list: comma-separated ISO alpha-2/alpha-3 codes or English names (up to 50). Omit for every country

min_us_level.description: Only US advisories at this level or higher (1-4); UK entries are then left out. Omit for all

pass.description: Optional Trip Desk Pass token (tp1....). With a valid pass this call is not charged. Prefer setting it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>.

source.description: Which government(s): both (default), us or uk
